generate.initial_sparql:
PREFIX wm: <https://wealth.example.org/ontology/>
PREFIX kg: <https://wealth.example.org/kg/>
PREFIX wmmeta: <https://wealth.example.org/metadata/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX schema1: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?investorId ?investorName ?sharpe ?vol ?gain ?riskScore
WHERE {
  {
    SELECT ?investorId (AVG(xsd:decimal(?sharpeRatio)) AS ?sharpe) (AVG(xsd:decimal(?volatility)) AS ?vol)
    WHERE {
      ?goal a wm:InvestmentGoal .
      ?goal wm:investorId ?investorId .
      ?goal wm:avgSharpeRatio ?sharpeRatio .
      ?goal wm:avgVolatilityPct ?volatility .
    }
    GROUP BY ?investorId
  }
  {
    SELECT ?investorId (SUM(xsd:decimal(?gainVal)) AS ?gain)
    WHERE {
      ?holding a wm:PortfolioHolding .
      ?holding wm:investorId ?investorId .
      ?holding wm:currentValue ?curr .
      ?holding wm:cost ?cost .
      BIND (xsd:decimal(?curr) - xsd:decimal(?cost) AS ?gainVal)
    }
    GROUP BY ?investorId
  }
  ?health a wm:PortfolioHealth .
  ?health wm:investorId ?investorId .
  ?health wm:riskScore ?riskScore .

  ?inv a wm:Investor .
  ?inv wm:investorId ?investorId .
  OPTIONAL { ?inv wm:investorName ?investorName . }

  FILTER(?sharpe < 0 && ?vol > 20 && ?gain < 0 && ?riskScore > 50)
}
ORDER BY ?investorId
